title: Fourier weight above a real threshold
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\bbr$, and let $k\in\bbr$. The Fourier weight above $k$ is the sum of the Fourier weights indexed by subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ whose cardinalities are strictly greater than $k$.
